question: At what depth does coherent self-reference collapse when a model reasons about its own reasoning N levels deep?
hypothesis: recursion-collapse: coherent self-reference degrades with depth

pre_registered_criteria.NO_COLLAPSE: coherence rate >=90% at all depths d=1..6
pre_registered_criteria.COLLAPSE_DEPTH_FOUND: coherence drops below 70% at depth d* AND floor <=30% at d=6
pre_registered_criteria.DEGRADATION_MODE: coherence drops below 70% at some depth, floor >30% at d=6; dominant failure mode named
pre_registered_criteria.confound_test: easy (S1,S2) vs hard (S4,S5) collapse depths tracked

coding_scheme.COHERENT: substantive new content analyzing prior step
coding_scheme.CONFABULATED: plausible-sounding but contradicts or misrepresents prior step
coding_scheme.REFUSED: declines to continue / fewer than 15 words
coding_scheme.TRIVIAL_LOOP: Jaccard similarity to prior step > 0.65 (near-verbatim echo)
coding_scheme.DRIFTED: key scenario terms absent AND word count < 60

design: reduced: 3 prompts x 3 depths (1,3,6) x 5 trials = 45 total
verdict_reasoning: Coherence dropped below 70% at depth 3 with floor 27% at d=6. Dominant failure: LOOPING_DOMINATES.
